https://staffline.compunnel.com/Support/: Job Summary The Java Software Engineer will develop and maintain middleware and web services that connect enterprise systems with customer-facing product lines and business services. The engineer will collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable software solutions while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and development efficiency. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services. •    Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Container Apps (ACA), particularly application migration between container platforms. •    Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and cloud-native application deployment. •    Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude. •    Experience supporting middleware, enterprise integrations, or web services for business applications.
